groups.operation: Destroy a parsed XMLDocument, including child cleanup through XMLNode destruction.
groups.condition: The parsed document contains child or nested nodes.
groups.capability: XMLDocument and XMLNode safely delete descendants while preserving ownership.
groups.consequence: Unsafe cleanup or failure to delete descendants.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same parsed-tree destruction operation and descendant-cleanup requirement, regardless of their differing assessments.

groups.condition: The caller passes a null node.
groups.capability: XMLDocument::DeleteNode handles null before asserting about the node.
groups.consequence: The assertion is reached for a null argument.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same direct null-call behavior.

groups.operation: Parse XML text with XMLDocument processEntities=false.
groups.condition: Text contains a recognized entity such as &.
groups.capability: The XMLDocument constructor can select processEntities=false so XMLText::ParseDeep retains the entity in the text value.
groups.consequence: The requested entity-preserving parse mode cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct constructor configuration and entity-processing behavior.

groups.operation: Parse XML text with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
groups.capability: The XMLDocument whitespace mode can select COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE for XMLText::ParseDeep.
groups.consequence: The requested whitespace-collapsing parse mode cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct whitespace mode and text transformation.

groups.operation: Parse an element with PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE selected.
groups.condition: An element contains whitespace-only text before its closing tag.
groups.capability: The XMLDocument whitespace mode can select PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE and retain the whitespace text node.
groups.consequence: The requested whitespace text node cannot be retained through this mode.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct whitespace mode and DOM result.
